<?php
class SendToken56 {
    public function __destruct() { echo 'D|'; }
}
function Body56() {
    $received = yield 'seed';
    echo 'VALUE|', (int) ($received === $GLOBALS['payload']);
    unset($GLOBALS['payload']);
    $reply = Fiber::suspend('pause');
    echo 'REPLY|', (int) ($reply === 'resume');
    unset($received);
    echo 'BUFFER|', (int) ($GLOBALS['weak']->get() !== null);
    yield 'done';
    echo 'BODY-END|';
    return 56;
}
function Run56() {
    global $g;
    echo 'CALL|';
    $value = $g->send($GLOBALS['payload']);
    echo 'SEND|', (int) ($value === 'done'), (int) ($GLOBALS['weak']->get() === null);
    return 'fiber';
}
$payload = new SendToken56();
$weak = WeakReference::create($payload);
$g = Body56();
echo 'SEED|', (int) ($g->current() === 'seed');
$f = new Fiber('Run56');
echo 'START|', (int) ($f->start() === 'pause');
echo 'PARKED|', (int) $f->isSuspended(), (int) ($weak->get() !== null);
echo 'RESUME|', (int) ($f->resume('resume') === null);
echo 'FIBER|', (int) ($f->getReturn() === 'fiber');
$g->next();
echo 'RETURN|', (int) ($g->getReturn() === 56);
unset($g, $f, $weak);
echo 'E';

<?php
class SendToken56 {
    public function __destruct() { echo 'D|'; }
}
function Body56() {
    $received = yield 'seed';
    echo 'VALUE|', (int) ($received === $GLOBALS['payload']);
    unset($GLOBALS['payload']);
    $reply = Fiber::suspend('pause');
    echo 'REPLY|', (int) ($reply === 'resume');
    yield $received;
    unset($received);
    echo 'BODY-END|';
    return 56;
}
function Run56() {
    global $g;
    echo 'CALL|';
    return $g->send($GLOBALS['payload']);
}
$payload = new SendToken56();
$weak = WeakReference::create($payload);
$g = Body56();
echo 'SEED|', (int) ($g->current() === 'seed');
$f = new Fiber('Run56');
echo 'START|', (int) ($f->start() === 'pause');
echo 'PARKED|', (int) $f->isSuspended(), (int) ($weak->get() !== null);
echo 'RESUME|', (int) ($f->resume('resume') === null);
$result = $f->getReturn();
echo 'RETURNED|', (int) ($weak->get() === $result);
$g->next();
echo 'CLOSED|', (int) ($g->getReturn() === 56);
unset($f, $result);
echo 'CACHE|', (int) ($weak->get() !== null);
unset($g);
echo 'FINAL|', (int) ($weak->get() === null);
unset($weak);
echo 'E';
